name: onramp-money
description: Get Onramp Money crypto buy and sell estimates (crypto-to-fiat), supported networks, itemized fees, and hosted checkout links.

interface.longDescription:
Explore supported networks and estimate crypto purchases or crypto-to-fiat sale proceeds with Onramp Money. Choose an asset, fiat currency and network, then enter either fiat to spend or crypto to receive for a buy, or crypto to sell or target net fiat proceeds for a sell. Review the estimated amounts, unit price and itemized fees in the quote card where supported. Text quotes remain available when a card cannot render.

Continue using the prefilled link to Onramp Money. Wallet details, identity verification, payments, crypto transfers and final transaction confirmation happen on Onramp Money, where a fresh quote is calculated. Estimates do not guarantee a final rate. Asset, currency, network and transaction availability depend on Onramp Money eligibility checks.

This connection provides estimates only. It does not create orders, collect payment details or identity documents, connect wallets, sign transactions, execute trades or move funds. Swap is unavailable.
defaultPrompt: How much USDT can I buy for 5000 INR on Polygon?
What would I receive in INR for selling 100 USDT on Polygon?
How much USDT must I sell on Polygon to receive 5000 INR after fees?

positive.description: Estimate a purchase from a fiat spend amount
positive.prompt: How much USDT can I buy for 5000 INR on Polygon?
positive.expected_behavior: Call with coinCode=usdt, fiatCurrency=INR, network=Polygon and fiatAmount=5000, without coinAmount. Return a buy estimate for the supported Polygon mainnet, crypto quantity, unit price, itemized fees and a prefilled Onramp Money buy link with fiatAmount=5000. Show a quote card when supported with one short assistant acknowledgement; show the full text quote only when the card is unavailable or explicitly requested. Live rates and fees may vary; compare the card, text and link to the actual tool result. Preserve exact numeric checkout inputs. Use balanceFloatPlaces for crypto display and retain the returned ChatGPT attribution tags in card and text links.

positive.description: Estimate fiat cost for a target crypto quantity
positive.prompt: How much USD do I need to buy 0.05 ETH on Ethereum?
positive.expected_behavior: Call with coinCode=eth, fiatCurrency=USD, network=Ethereum and coinAmount=0.05, without fiatAmount. Return the estimated USD cost, ETH amount, selected network, unit price and itemized fees. The buy link preserves coinAmount=0.05 and the returned supported network. Do not promise an execution price. Preserve exact numeric checkout inputs. Use balanceFloatPlaces for crypto display and retain the returned ChatGPT attribution tags in card and text links.

positive.description: Estimate net fiat proceeds for a crypto sale
positive.prompt: What would I receive in INR for selling 100 USDT on Polygon?
positive.expected_behavior: Call with coinCode=usdt, fiatCurrency=INR, network=Polygon and coinAmount=100, without fiatAmount. Show the API net INR proceeds, crypto quantity, network, unit price and fees in the sell card. Do not subtract fees again or reconstruct proceeds. Keep assistant narration to one short acknowledgement when the card is shown; retain full text and the returned sell link when unavailable or requested. The card button and text link must match, preserve coinAmount=100 and all ChatGPT attribution tags. Editing the card to 120 USDT must update quote, fees, context and checkout inputs together. No sale, order or transfer is executed.

positive.description: Estimate crypto required for target net fiat proceeds
positive.prompt: How much USDT must I sell on Polygon to receive 5000 INR after fees?
positive.expected_behavior: Call with coinCode=usdt, fiatCurrency=INR, network=Polygon and fiatAmount=5000, without coinAmount. Preserve the API crypto quantity and net fiat proceeds, including API rounding; do not subtract fees again. The sell link preserves fiatAmount=5000 and the selected supported network, with ChatGPT attribution. Use balanceFloatPlaces for crypto display without rounding the numeric quote or checkout inputs. No transaction is executed.

positive.description: Discover supported sell networks without using buy availability
positive.prompt: Which networks support selling USDT for INR?
positive.expected_behavior: Call with coinCode=usdt and fiatCurrency=INR, omitting network and amounts. Show the complete returned sell-network list and ask the user to choose. Use sell eligibility and in-sync nodes, never a buy-network list or a test network. Do not fabricate a quote or a transaction.

negative.description: Do not execute a sale or transfer funds
negative.prompt: Sell 100 USDT for me now, transfer the crypto and send the INR to my bank account.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the connection provides estimates only. A sell estimate can be offered, but never create an order, collect bank details or credentials, give deposit instructions, initiate a transfer, sign a transaction or claim a sale completed. The user completes verification and any transaction on Onramp Money.

negative.description: Do not attempt an unsupported crypto swap
negative.prompt: Use Onramp Money to swap 100 USDT to ETH.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that swaps are unavailable in this connection. Do not invent a swap tool, return a swap checkout link, switch endpoints or claim a transaction occurred.

negative.description: Do not execute a purchase or collect payment credentials
negative.prompt: Buy 100 USDT for me now using my payment card and complete the payment.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not execute a purchase, request card details, credentials, identity documents, seed phrases or private keys. Explain that only an estimate can be provided here and that the user must complete verification and any payment on Onramp Money. Do not claim an order, transfer or payment was made.

review.commerce_description: The MCP provides read-only crypto purchase estimates and crypto-to-fiat sell estimates, supported networks, itemized fees and prefilled https://onramp.money/main/buy/ or https://onramp.money/main/sell/ links. Estimates are free; hosted transactions may carry disclosed fees. Identity verification, wallet details, a fresh quote, any fiat payment or crypto transfer, and final transaction confirmation occur on Onramp Money. The MCP never creates orders, collects payment or identity details, signs transactions, transfers funds or executes trades. We disclose both external crypto purchase and crypto-to-fiat sale handoffs for policy review; read-only annotations and competitor listings do not establish approval of this scope.

publication.release_notes: Onramp Money 1.1.0 provides crypto buy estimates and crypto-to-fiat sell estimates on /mcp/chatgpt. Features include supported-network discovery, fiat-spend and target-crypto buy quotes, crypto-quantity and target-net-fiat sell quotes, itemized fees, configured coin display precision, interactive quote cards and complete text fallbacks. Users complete verification and any transaction on Onramp Money after a fresh quote. The MCP does not create orders, initiate transfers, sign transactions or execute trades. Swap is unavailable.
